title: Reliable Portal Based Shulker Farm [1.17 Java Edition]
description:
The shulker warp has been patched so it's time to update and finalise the shulker farm. In this video you will also get a detailed tutorial of how to set up your own shulker farm.

PLEASE NOTE I have switched out the schematics for a new and optimised version of the farm, this means the schematics will differ slightly from the video however the farm is mostly the same.
